root: ^Well most of them were adventurers and expected me to follow suit. They originally came here to Günhildr just for Agathol and all its riches.
^They were allegedly pretty successful at first but as Agathol started to dry up, so did our cash.
^And then more and more of them started disappearing and yeah I'm sure you’ve heard that all before.
^There's not many of us left. Just me and my sister now.
^Eh, don’t be. They knew what they got themselves into.
^Just makes me think I chose the right career path.
